why: the read half of `c:action_publish_status`. The per-goal query ours offers is `rclc_action_get_goal_status(server, goal, status*)` and the sweep is C++'s `ActionServer::for_each_active_goal`; neither materialises an array, because there is no allocator to materialise it into. A user loses the ability to read every goal's status as one message.
